cases.title: Steady Power Operation
cases.description: Six hundred seconds without a fault should stay close to the reference operating band.

cases.title: Loss Of Feedwater With AFW
cases.eventFamily: NRC SRP 15.2.7 loss of normal feedwater flow
cases.description: Main feedwater trips; auxiliary feedwater starts and should preserve a secondary heat sink.

cases.title: Steam Generator Tube Leak
cases.eventFamily: NRC SRP 15.6.3 steam generator tube failure indication
cases.description: Primary-to-secondary leakage should drain RCS inventory and produce affected-secondary radiation.

cases.title: Small LOCA With Accumulator Response
cases.description: A primary boundary leak should depressurize, send mass to containment, and actuate passive inventory support.

cases.title: Loss Of Forced Primary Flow
cases.eventFamily: NRC SRP 15.3.1 loss of forced reactor coolant flow
cases.description: All reactor coolant pumps trip; loop flow should coast down and core cooling indicators should respond.

cases.title: Loss Of Offsite Power
cases.eventFamily: NRC SRP 15.2.6 loss of nonemergency AC power
cases.description: Offsite power is lost; emergency diesels should restore safety buses and essential loads.

results.label: Pressurizer pressure remains in the reference operating band
results.expectation: Stable PWR operation should remain close to nominal RCS pressure.

results.label: Steam-generator level remains controllable
results.expectation: Normal operation should not drift toward dryout or high-level challenge.

results.label: Electric output remains in the reference plant range
results.expectation: The reference plant should produce a plausible large-PWR electrical output at power.

results.label: Loss of feedwater visibly lowers SG level before recovery
results.signal: sgA.levelPercent delta from T+80s to T+170s
results.expectation: Normal feedwater loss should deplete secondary inventory before AFW recovery.

results.label: Auxiliary feedwater reaches the affected SG branch
results.expectation: AFW should provide a visible secondary heat-sink recovery path.

results.label: AFW recovery avoids SG dryout in the demo window
results.expectation: The modeled recovery should preserve a usable heat sink during the scenario.

results.label: SGTR produces measurable primary-to-secondary leakage
results.expectation: A tube leak should create an affected-SG leak path without contaminating unrelated SGs.

results.label: SGTR drains primary inventory
results.signal: vessel.primaryCoolantInventoryKg delta from T+80s to final
results.expectation: Primary-to-secondary leakage should produce a durable RCS inventory consequence.

results.label: Affected secondary radiation rises
results.expectation: SGTR diagnosis should be visible through affected secondary radiation.

results.label: Primary boundary leak creates containment release flow
results.expectation: A primary-boundary break should move mass from RCS to containment.

results.label: Containment pressure rises after release
results.signal: containment.pressureMPa delta from T+80s to final
results.expectation: Containment should respond thermodynamically to primary mass-energy release.

results.label: Accumulator injects after depressurization
results.expectation: Passive safety injection should become visible as RCS pressure falls below the accumulator head.

results.label: Forced primary flow coasts down rather than teleporting to zero
results.signal: rcpA.loopFlowKgPerS delta from T+88s to T+110s
results.expectation: RCP trip should show inertia/coastdown, not an instant hydraulic collapse.

results.label: Core cooling availability responds to loss of forced flow
results.expectation: Loss of forced primary flow should be visible in core cooling diagnostics.

results.label: Fuel heatup remains bounded in the demo window
results.expectation: The compact model should show thermal consequence without claiming severe-accident fidelity.

results.label: Safety bus A recovers after diesel start
results.expectation: LOOP should be visible but recover essential safety bus voltage after EDG start.

results.label: Safety bus B recovers after diesel start
results.expectation: LOOP should be visible but recover redundant safety bus voltage after EDG start.

results.label: Essential plant-control loads remain served after recovery
results.expectation: Emergency power recovery should preserve essential control loads.
